body_zh: 这家食堂周三中午共售出盒饭412份，红烧鸡块最受欢迎，卖出156份，番茄炒蛋卖出98份，素菜拼盘卖出73份，剩余米饭约12公斤，厨房在下午两点前完成了全部清洗，晚餐备料从三点开始。
body_en: This canteen sold 412 boxed lunches at noon on Wednesday. Braised chicken was the most popular dish with 156 portions sold, tomato and egg stir fry sold 98, and the vegetable platter sold 73. About 12 kilograms of rice were left over, the kitchen finished all cleaning before two in the afternoon, and dinner preparation started at three.

body_zh: 一份家常红烧肉菜谱列出了主要用量，五花肉500克，冰糖30克，生抽20毫升，老抽10毫升，八角两颗和姜片五片，加水量以没过肉块为准，小火炖煮约60分钟，成品可供四人食用。
body_en: A recipe for homestyle braised pork lists the main quantities. It uses 500 grams of pork belly, 30 grams of rock sugar, 20 milliliters of light soy sauce, 10 milliliters of dark soy sauce, two star anise and five slices of ginger. Enough water is added to cover the meat, the pot simmers over low heat for about 60 minutes, and the dish serves four people.

body_zh: 这间餐馆的后厨长约十二米，靠墙排着四台燃气灶，灶台上方装有一条宽大的排烟罩，中间是一张不锈钢操作台，台面下层放着砧板和铁盆，冷库门在最里侧，地面铺着防滑砖，排水沟沿墙而设。
body_en: The back kitchen of this restaurant is about twelve meters long. Four gas stoves stand in a row along the wall under a wide exhaust hood, and a stainless steel worktable sits in the middle with cutting boards and metal basins on its lower shelf. The door to the cold room is at the far end, the floor is laid with nonslip tiles, and a drainage channel runs along the wall.

body_zh: 这口铸铁炖锅重约四公斤，锅身呈深红色，内壁是米白色的珐琅涂层，锅盖内侧有一圈凸起的小点，可以让水汽凝结后滴回锅中，两侧的把手较宽，锅底平整，适合放在燃气灶上或烤箱里使用。
body_en: This cast iron casserole weighs about four kilograms. Its body is deep red, and the inside has a cream colored enamel coating. The underside of the lid has a ring of raised dots that let condensed steam drip back into the pot. The two handles are wide and the base is flat, so the pot works on a gas stove or in an oven.

body_zh: 制作手工饺子时，厨师先把面粉和温水揉成光滑的面团，盖上湿布静置半小时，随后将猪肉末与白菜碎拌成馅料，再把面团搓条切剂，擀成圆皮，包入馅料后捏紧边缘，最后放入沸水中煮到饺子浮起。
body_en: To make dumplings by hand, the cook first kneads flour and warm water into a smooth dough and lets it rest under a damp cloth for half an hour. Minced pork and chopped cabbage are then mixed into a filling. The dough is rolled into a rope, cut into small pieces and rolled out into round wrappers, which are filled and pinched shut. Finally the dumplings are boiled until they float.

body_zh: 烤制戚风蛋糕分为几个阶段，先将蛋黄与牛奶和植物油搅匀，再筛入低筋面粉，另一边把蛋白分三次加糖打发，然后把两部分轻轻翻拌，倒入模具后放进160度的烤箱烘烤约50分钟，出炉后立即倒扣晾凉。
body_en: Baking a chiffon cake goes through several stages. Egg yolks are first whisked with milk and vegetable oil, and cake flour is sifted in. Separately, the egg whites are beaten while sugar is added in three portions. The two mixtures are then gently folded together, poured into a pan and baked at 160 degrees for about 50 minutes. As soon as it comes out of the oven, the cake is turned upside down to cool.

body_zh: 上周六傍晚，一家面馆的厨房突然停电，正在熬制的骨汤只好暂时离火，几名厨师借着手电筒的光继续切配，店长临时把菜单改成凉面和拌菜，四十分钟后电力恢复，晚市照常营业，当晚接待了六十多桌客人。
body_en: Last Saturday evening, the kitchen of a noodle shop suddenly lost power. The bone broth on the stove had to be taken off the heat for a while, and several cooks kept cutting ingredients by flashlight. The manager temporarily switched the menu to cold noodles and dressed side dishes. Power came back forty minutes later, dinner service went on as usual, and the shop served more than sixty tables that night.

body_zh: 一所职业学校的烹饪班举办了年终厨艺比赛，二十名学生分成五组，每组在九十分钟内完成一道热菜和一道点心，评委从刀工和火候以及摆盘三方面打分，一名学生用萝卜雕成的花朵引来围观，最终，第三组的清蒸鱼获得了最高分。
body_en: The cooking class of a vocational school held a cooking contest at the end of the year. Twenty students were divided into five groups, and each group made one hot dish and one pastry within ninety minutes. The judges scored knife work, heat control and plating. A flower carved from a radish by one student drew a crowd. In the end, the steamed fish of the third group received the highest score.

body_zh: 面团发酵依靠酵母分解糖分并产生二氧化碳，气体被面筋网络包住后，面团就会膨胀变松，温度在28度左右时酵母最为活跃，温度过低发酵会明显变慢，盐放得太多也会抑制酵母，所以和面时盐和酵母通常分开加入。
body_en: Dough rises because yeast breaks down sugar and produces carbon dioxide. Once the gas is trapped in the gluten network, the dough expands and turns light. Yeast is most active at around 28 degrees, and fermentation slows noticeably when the temperature is too low. Too much salt also holds back the yeast, so salt and yeast are usually added separately when the dough is mixed.

body_zh: 油炸食物时油温的高低决定了口感，油温在150度上下时适合炸制较厚的肉块，可以让内部慢慢熟透，油温升到180度时外层会迅速变脆，适合炸薯条和天妇罗，油温过高时油会冒出浓烟，食物表面也容易焦黑。
body_en: In deep frying, the oil temperature determines the texture. Oil at around 150 degrees suits thicker pieces of meat because it lets the inside cook through slowly. At 180 degrees the outer layer turns crisp quickly, which suits fries and tempura. When the oil gets too hot, it gives off thick smoke and the surface of the food easily burns black.

body_zh: 某市青少年游泳馆本月共开放26天，累计接待训练人员1840人次，晨训班平均每天到场35人，周末两天的人数最多，池水每天检测三次，水温保持在27度，馆内还更换了12条泳道分隔线。
body_en: A youth swimming hall in a city was open for 26 days this month and received 1,840 training visits in total. The morning training class averaged 35 swimmers a day, and the two weekend days were the busiest. The pool water was tested three times a day and kept at 27 degrees, and 12 lane dividers in the hall were also replaced.

body_zh: 在一场县级田径运动会上，男子400米决赛的冠军成绩为52秒，女子跳远的最好成绩是5米36，全场共有312名运动员参赛，比赛分两天进行，期间打破了三项县纪录，第二天下午因小雨暂停了二十分钟。
body_en: At a county track and field meet, the winner of the 400 meter final for men finished in 52 seconds, and the best long jump among women measured 5 meters 36 centimeters. A total of 312 athletes took part over two days, three county records were broken, and on the afternoon of the second day the meet was paused for twenty minutes because of light rain.

body_zh: 这座体育馆的主场地可以容纳两块篮球场，木地板涂着浅黄色的漆，四周看台共有九排座位，可坐约两千人，最高处装着一块电子记分牌，场地两端各有一扇通往更衣室的门，屋顶的天窗在白天能透进柔和的光线。
body_en: The main floor of this gymnasium has room for two basketball courts, and its wooden boards are coated in pale yellow varnish. The stands around it have nine rows of seats for about two thousand people, and an electronic scoreboard is mounted at the highest point. At each end of the floor a door leads to a locker room, and skylights in the roof let in soft light during the day.

body_zh: 一块标准的乒乓球拍由底板和两面胶皮组成，底板通常用多层木片压制而成，握柄分为直拍和横拍两种形状，红色和黑色胶皮分别贴在两面，胶皮下面垫着一层海绵，海绵越厚，击球时的弹性就越大。
body_en: A standard table tennis paddle consists of a blade and two rubber sheets. The blade is usually pressed from several layers of wood, and the handle comes in two shapes, penhold and shakehand. A red sheet and a black sheet are glued to the two sides, each over a layer of sponge. The thicker the sponge, the more bounce the paddle gives when it strikes the ball.

body_zh: 马拉松选手的赛前准备通常持续十六周，前四周以慢跑打基础，每周跑量逐步增加，中间八周加入间歇跑和长距离耐力跑，最后四周开始减量，比赛前一周只保留轻松跑，赛前三天会多吃米饭和面条储存糖原。
body_en: A marathon runner usually prepares for a race over sixteen weeks. The first four weeks build a base with easy jogging, and the weekly distance rises step by step. The middle eight weeks add interval runs and long endurance runs. The last four weeks cut back the load, only easy runs remain in the final week, and in the three days before the race the runner eats more rice and noodles to store glycogen.

body_zh: 一场排球比赛开始前，裁判先检查球网高度和比赛用球的气压，随后双方队长挑边，抽中发球权的一方在第一局开球，每局先得25分并领先两分的队伍获胜，局间休息三分钟，若打到第五局，则先得15分并领先两分的一方赢下比赛。
body_en: Before a volleyball match begins, the referee checks the net height and the pressure of the match ball. The two captains then choose sides, and the team that wins the serve starts the first set. A set goes to the first team to reach 25 points with a two point lead, and there is a three minute break between sets. If the match goes to a fifth set, the first team to reach 15 points with a two point lead wins.

body_zh: 一支业余足球队在周日的联赛中以二比一逆转对手，上半场他们先丢一球，中场休息时教练调整了阵型，换上两名速度快的边锋，第七十分钟球队扳平比分，补时阶段一记角球被中卫顶进球门，看台上的家属纷纷起身鼓掌。
body_en: An amateur football team came from behind to win a league match two to one on Sunday. The team conceded first in the first half, and at halftime the coach changed the formation and brought on two fast wingers. The team leveled the score in the seventieth minute, and in stoppage time a center back headed a corner kick into the goal, as family members in the stands rose to applaud.

body_zh: 市体育中心的室外网球场去年秋天完成了翻新，施工队铲掉了开裂的旧面层，重新铺设了蓝绿两色的硬地，并加装了夜间照明灯，重新开放的第一个周末，前来打球的人很多，八块场地从早上七点一直排满到晚上九点。
body_en: The outdoor tennis courts at the city sports center were renovated last autumn. The work crew removed the cracked old surface, laid a new hard court in blue and green, and added lights for night play. On the first weekend after reopening, many people came to play, and all eight courts were booked from seven in the morning until nine at night.

body_zh: 篮球比赛设有进攻时限，一方获得控球权后在24秒内投篮出手，球碰到篮筐后才会重新计时，一旦时间耗尽仍未出手，就判为违例，球权交给对方，这条规则让比赛节奏更快，也减少了拖延时间的打法。
body_en: Basketball has a shot clock. After gaining possession, a team has 24 seconds to attempt a shot, and the clock resets only after the ball touches the rim. If time runs out before a shot, a violation is called and possession goes to the other team. This rule speeds up the game and cuts down on stalling tactics.

body_zh: 跳高比赛采用逐级升杆的方式，每个高度运动员最多有三次试跳机会，连续三次失败即被淘汰，运动员可以选择免跳某个高度，如果最后成绩相同，就比较在该高度上的失败次数，失败次数少的名次靠前。
body_en: High jump competitions raise the bar step by step. At each height an athlete has at most three attempts, and three failures in a row mean elimination. An athlete may choose to pass a height. If final heights are equal, the numbers of failures at that height are compared, and the athlete with fewer failures ranks higher.

body_zh: 一支社区管乐团在本季度共排练了22次，平均每次到场41人，缺席最多的是长号声部，演出曲目由九首增加到十四首，其中两首是团里的指挥改编的民歌，季度末的汇报演出售出门票380张，剩余座位留给了附近学校的学生。
body_en: A community wind band held 22 rehearsals this quarter, with an average of 41 players at each one, and the trombone section had the most absences. The repertoire grew from nine pieces to fourteen, two of them folk songs arranged by the band conductor. The showcase concert at the end of the quarter sold 380 tickets, and the remaining seats went to students from nearby schools.

body_zh: 一家琴行的调律师上个月共上门服务57次，经手的琴里有49台立式钢琴和8台三角钢琴，平均每台用时约一个半小时，有11台钢琴的音高偏低较多，分两次才调到标准音高，另有4台更换了断裂的琴弦。
body_en: Last month a piano tuner from a music store made 57 house calls, working on 49 upright pianos and 8 grand pianos. Each piano took about an hour and a half on average. Eleven pianos were pitched well below standard and took two visits to bring up to pitch, and another 4 had broken strings replaced.

body_zh: 这座音乐厅的观众席呈马蹄形，共有三层，池座铺着深红色地毯，舞台背后立着一架管风琴，银色的音管从矮到高排成扇面，天花板上悬挂着几十块弧形的反声板，墙面贴着凹凸不平的木质饰板。
body_en: The seating in this concert hall is shaped like a horseshoe and rises in three tiers. The stalls are covered with dark red carpet, and a pipe organ stands behind the stage, its silver pipes arranged from short to tall in a fan. Dozens of curved acoustic reflectors hang from the ceiling, and the walls are lined with uneven wooden panels.

body_zh: 这把大提琴的面板用云杉制成，背板和侧板是带有虎纹的枫木，琴身长约75厘米，表面涂着琥珀色的油漆，琴颈顶端是一个雕成卷轴形状的琴头，四根琴弦从琴头延伸到琴尾，底部伸出一根可以调节长度的金属尾柱。
body_en: The top of this cello is made of spruce, and the back and sides are of flamed maple. The body is about 75 centimeters long and coated with amber varnish. The neck ends in a head carved into a scroll, four strings run from the head down to the tail, and a metal endpin of adjustable length extends from the bottom.

body_zh: 一场交响音乐会开场前，乐手们提前一小时到后台换好演出服，开演前十分钟陆续登台就座，首席小提琴手最后入场，示意双簧管给出标准音，全体乐器依次校音，随后指挥走上舞台，向观众鞠躬后举起指挥棒。
body_en: Before a symphony concert, the musicians arrive backstage an hour early to change into concert dress. Ten minutes before the start they take their seats on stage one by one. The concertmaster enters last and signals the oboe to sound the tuning note, and the whole orchestra tunes in turn. The conductor then walks onto the stage, bows to the audience and raises the baton.

body_zh: 录音棚里录制一首流行歌曲往往分几步完成，先由鼓手和贝斯手录下节奏轨，接着叠加吉他和键盘，然后歌手分段录唱主旋律，和声部分另行录制，所有音轨录完后交给混音师调整音量和声场，母带处理是最后一道工序。
body_en: Recording a pop song in a studio usually takes several steps. The drummer and bassist first record the rhythm track, and guitar and keyboards are then layered on top. The singer records the lead vocal in sections, and the harmonies are recorded separately. Once all the tracks are done, a mixing engineer balances the levels and the stereo image, and mastering is the final step.

body_zh: 上个月的一场露天音乐会进行到一半时下起了阵雨，工作人员迅速给舞台边的音箱盖上防水布，乐队暂停了约十五分钟，观众大多留在原地，雨停后演出继续，原本安排的十二首曲目全部演完，散场时不少观众的雨衣还在滴水。
body_en: Halfway through an open air concert last month, a rain shower began. The crew quickly covered the speakers beside the stage with tarps, and the band paused for about fifteen minutes while most of the audience stayed put. The show resumed after the rain stopped, all twelve planned songs were played, and as the crowd left, many raincoats were still dripping.

body_zh: 一所中学的合唱团在省级比赛中获得了金奖，这支队伍由四十六名学生组成，参赛曲目是一首无伴奏的民谣和一首现代作品，赛前，他们每天午休时排练半小时，领唱的女生在高音段落表现稳定，评委特别提到了声部之间的平衡。
body_en: A middle school choir won a gold award at a provincial competition. The group has 46 students, and its program was an unaccompanied folk song and a modern piece. Before the competition, the students rehearsed for half an hour every day during the lunch break. The girl singing the solo was steady in the high passages, and the judges specifically mentioned the balance between the voice parts.

body_zh: 弦乐器的音高取决于琴弦的长度和张力以及粗细，弦越短，张力越大，振动就越快，发出的声音也越高，演奏者用手指按住琴弦，相当于缩短了振动部分，因此手指越靠近琴码，音就越高。
body_en: The pitch of a string instrument depends on the length, tension and thickness of the string. The shorter and tighter the string, the faster it vibrates and the higher the sound it makes. Pressing a finger on a string shortens the vibrating part, so the closer the finger is to the bridge, the higher the note.

body_zh: 五线谱用五条平行的横线记录音高，音符的位置越高，代表的音也越高，谱号放在每行的开头，用来确定各条线上的音名，高音谱号多用于小提琴和长笛，低音谱号多用于大提琴和大号，拍号则标明每小节的拍数。
body_en: A staff records pitch on five parallel horizontal lines. The higher a note sits, the higher its pitch. A clef at the start of each row of music fixes the note names of the lines. The treble clef is mostly used for violin and flute, the bass clef mostly for cello and tuba, and the time signature shows how many beats each measure has.

body_zh: 一家市立美术馆的春季画展共持续45天，展出油画和水彩作品128幅，累计参观人数约2万6千人，周末的日均客流是工作日的三倍，馆方在第二十天加印了两千份导览手册，闭展后有9幅作品被借往外地展出。
body_en: The spring painting exhibition at a city art museum ran for 45 days and showed 128 oil paintings and watercolors. About 26 thousand visitors came in total, and average daily attendance on weekends was three times that on weekdays. On the twentieth day the museum printed two thousand more guide booklets, and after the exhibition closed, 9 works were lent to shows in other cities.

body_zh: 一座雕塑公园的年度巡查记录显示，园内共有露天雕塑63件，青铜材质的有27件，石材的有21件，其余15件为不锈钢，有8件出现了表面锈斑或裂缝，修复团队用了五周时间完成处理，草坪周边新增了14块说明牌。
body_en: The annual inspection record of a sculpture park lists 63 outdoor sculptures, 27 in bronze, 21 in stone and the other 15 in stainless steel. Eight of them showed surface rust spots or cracks, and a restoration team spent five weeks treating them. Fourteen new information signs were added around the lawns.

body_zh: 美术馆二楼的主展厅是一个长方形的空间，墙面刷成浅灰色，天花板上排列着可以调节角度的轨道射灯，展厅中央摆着两张没有靠背的长凳，入口处立着一块介绍展览的白色展板，地面是打磨过的水泥，走动时几乎没有回声。
body_en: The main exhibition hall on the second floor of the art museum is a rectangular space with pale gray walls. Track spotlights with adjustable angles line the ceiling, and two backless benches sit in the middle of the room. A white panel introducing the exhibition stands at the entrance, and the floor of polished concrete gives almost no echo underfoot.

body_zh: 这尊青铜雕塑高约两米，塑造的是一位坐在石块上读书的老人，他微微低头，左手托着摊开的书页，衣褶的线条很深，表面经过氧化处理后呈现出暗绿色，底座是一块方形花岗岩，四角被雨水冲得十分光滑。
body_en: This bronze sculpture is about two meters tall and depicts an old man reading while seated on a rock. His head is slightly bowed, and his left hand holds the open pages of a book. The folds of his clothing are deeply cut, and after oxidation the surface has turned dark green. The base is a square block of granite whose corners have been worn smooth by rain.

body_zh: 一幅油画从库房到展厅会经过多道工序，工作人员先核对编号并拍照存档，再检查画面和画框有无损伤，接着把画装进定制的木箱运往展厅，开箱后静置一天，让画布与室内温度相近，最后由两人配合挂上墙并校正水平。
body_en: An oil painting goes through several steps on its way from the storeroom to the gallery. Staff first check its number and photograph it for the records, then inspect the painted surface and the frame for damage. The painting is packed into a custom wooden crate and moved to the gallery. After unpacking it rests for a day so the canvas can match the room temperature, and finally two people hang it on the wall together and level it.

body_zh: 石雕的制作通常从选料开始，雕塑家先用黏土捏出小稿，再按比例在石块上标出关键点，然后用电锯和錾子去掉大块余料，接下来逐步细化五官和衣纹，表面用砂纸由粗到细打磨，整个过程可能持续数月。
body_en: Making a stone carving usually starts with choosing the stone. The sculptor first shapes a small clay study, then marks key points on the block according to scale, and removes large pieces of excess stone with a power saw and chisels. The facial features and folds of clothing are refined step by step, and the surface is sanded from coarse to fine. The whole process can take several months.

body_zh: 上周四下午，一名小学生在参观画展时不小心碰倒了展厅里的一个立牌，立牌倒地时撞到了旁边的雕塑底座，保安立即拉起了临时围挡，修复人员检查后确认雕塑没有受损，带队老师当场向工作人员致歉，展厅在半小时后重新开放。
body_en: Last Thursday afternoon, a primary school pupil visiting an exhibition accidentally knocked over a sign stand in the gallery. As it fell, the stand struck the base of a nearby sculpture. Security staff immediately put up a temporary barrier. Conservators examined the sculpture and confirmed it was undamaged, the teacher leading the group apologized to the staff on the spot, and the gallery reopened half an hour later.

body_zh: 一位年轻画家的首次个展在城东的一间小画廊开幕，展出的二十多幅作品都以旧街区的屋顶为题材，画面多用灰蓝色调，开幕当天，来了一百多位观众，有三幅画在第一周就被收藏者买下，画廊因此把展期延长了十天。
body_en: The first solo exhibition of a young painter opened at a small gallery on the east side of the city. The twenty or so works on view all take the rooftops of an old neighborhood as their subject, mostly in grayish blue tones. More than a hundred visitors came on opening day, three paintings were bought by collectors in the first week, and the gallery extended the show by ten days as a result.

body_zh: 油画在展厅墙面上悬挂时，画面中心通常位于离地约150厘米的高度，这个高度接近成年观众平视的视线。相邻两幅作品之间一般留出不少于60厘米的空隙，尺寸较大的作品前方还会留出更宽的观看距离，以免观众挤在一处。
body_en: When oil paintings are hung on gallery walls, the center of each picture is usually placed about 150 centimeters above the floor, close to the eye level of an adult visitor. Neighboring works are normally spaced at least 60 centimeters apart, and larger works are given a wider viewing distance in front, so that visitors do not crowd into one spot.

body_zh: 雕塑的铸造版次是判断作品价值的一项依据，青铜雕塑可以用同一个模具浇铸多件，艺术家通常会限定总数，例如只铸八件，每件底座上刻有编号，超过限定数量后再铸出的作品一般不被视为原作版次。
body_en: The casting edition of a sculpture is one basis for judging its value. A bronze sculpture can be cast several times from the same mold, and artists usually limit the total, for example to eight casts. Each base is engraved with a number, and casts made beyond the set limit are generally not considered part of the original edition.

body_zh: 一家出版社去年共出版新书214种，其中少儿读物68种，科普读物41种，文学作品55种，其余为工具书和教材，首印总量约86万册，有17种图书在一年内加印，退货率比前年下降了两个百分点。
body_en: Last year a publishing house released 214 new titles, including 68 titles for children, 41 popular science titles and 55 literary works, with reference books and textbooks making up the rest. First printings totaled about 860 thousand copies, 17 titles were reprinted within the year, and the return rate fell by two percentage points from the year before.

body_zh: 某印刷厂本周的生产日志显示，三台胶印机共运行了96个小时，印完图书五种，合计用纸约42吨，周二因更换橡皮布停机两小时，抽检的300本成品中发现4本装订歪斜，已全部挑出返工。
body_en: The production log of a printing plant for this week shows that three offset presses ran for 96 hours in total and finished five book titles, using about 42 tons of paper. On Tuesday the presses stopped for two hours to change the blankets. Of 300 finished copies checked at random, 4 had crooked binding, and all of them were pulled out for rework.

body_zh: 这本精装画册的开本接近正方形，封面裹着深蓝色的布面，书名用烫金工艺压在正中，书脊是圆背设计，内页使用厚实的哑光铜版纸，共有240页，每一页的边缘都裁得很齐，书里夹着一根米色的丝带书签。
body_en: This hardcover art book is nearly square. The cover is wrapped in dark blue cloth with the title stamped in gold at the center, and the spine is rounded. The inner pages are thick matte coated paper, 240 pages in all, each trimmed to a clean edge, and a beige silk ribbon marker lies between the pages.

body_zh: 印刷厂的装订车间里有一条长长的流水线，配页机把一叠叠书帖按顺序叠好，传送带把书芯送到胶订机，热熔胶在这里涂上书脊，包好封面的书随后进入三面切书机，车间一角堆着用塑料膜缠好的成品，等待装车。
body_en: The binding workshop of the printing plant has a long production line. A gathering machine stacks the signatures in order, and a conveyor carries the book blocks to the perfect binder, where hot melt glue is applied to the spine. The covered books then pass into a three knife trimmer. In one corner of the workshop, finished copies wrapped in plastic film are stacked and waiting to be loaded onto trucks.

body_zh: 一部书稿从交稿到出版大致经历以下环节，编辑先通读全稿并提出修改意见，作者修订后进入三审三校，排版人员完成版式设计，校对员核对错字和标点，封面设计稿确定后，印厂打样，样书确认无误才开机付印。
body_en: A manuscript goes through roughly the following stages from submission to publication. An editor first reads the whole manuscript and suggests revisions, and after the author revises it, the text goes through three rounds of review and three rounds of proofreading. Typesetters complete the page layout, and proofreaders check for typos and punctuation errors. Once the cover design is final, the printer makes proofs, and the press run starts only after the sample copy is confirmed to be correct.

body_zh: 胶版印刷的一个印次从制版开始，印前人员把排好的页面输出到铝制印版上，印版装上印刷机的滚筒后，机长调节墨量和水量，先印几十张试样比对颜色，色彩合格后正式开印，印好的大张纸晾干后再送去折页。
body_en: An offset print run begins with platemaking. Prepress staff output the typeset pages onto aluminum plates, and once the plates are mounted on the press cylinders, the press operator adjusts the ink and water levels. A few dozen test sheets are printed first to compare the colors, and the full run begins when the colors pass. The large printed sheets are left to dry and then sent for folding.

body_zh: 某出版社的一本新书即将上市时，编辑发现封底的定价印错了，三千册图书已经装箱，编辑部当天联系印厂，工人们用了两天时间给每本书贴上新的价签，发货日期因此推迟了三天，新书仍在月底前如期上架。
body_en: Just before a new book from a publishing house went on sale, an editor noticed that the price on the back cover had been printed wrong. Three thousand copies were already boxed. The editorial office contacted the printer the same day, and workers spent two days putting a new price sticker on every copy. Shipping was delayed by three days as a result, but the book still reached the shelves before the end of the month as planned.

body_zh: 去年冬天，一位退休的中学老师把多年收集的乡村老照片整理成书，出版社为这本书专门组织了三轮选图，最终收录了312张照片，首印两千册在两个月内售完，当地图书馆还为它举办了一场小型展览。
body_en: Last winter, a retired middle school teacher compiled old village photographs collected over many years into a book. The publisher organized three rounds of image selection for it, and 312 photographs were included in the end. The first printing of two thousand copies sold out within two months, and the local library also held a small exhibition for the book.

body_zh: 每本正式出版的图书都有一个国际标准书号，它由13位数字组成，依次表示前缀，出版国家或语种，出版者和具体书目，最后一位是校验码，由前面12位数字计算得出，可以发现录入时的错误。
body_en: Every formally published book has an International Standard Book Number. It consists of 13 digits that indicate, in order, a prefix, the country or language of publication, the publisher and the specific title. The last digit is a check digit calculated from the first 12, and it helps catch errors made during data entry.

body_zh: 书籍印刷时通常把多个页面拼在一张大纸上，这张纸经过折叠后形成一个书帖，常见的书帖有16页或32页，因此一本书的总页数大多是16的倍数，如果正文页数不足，排版时会在书末加入空白页或广告页来补齐。
body_en: In book printing, several pages are usually laid out on one large sheet, which is folded to form a signature. Common signatures have 16 or 32 pages, so the total page count of a book is mostly a multiple of 16. If the main text falls short, blank pages or advertisement pages are added at the end during typesetting to fill the gap.
